h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Vijayanagaram

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Vijayanagaram

items.pText: Once children reach nine or ten, a slide and a swing rarely hold their interest for long, and schools in Vijayanagaram often ask what to add for older pupils. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for all ages, including climbing and balancing pieces for older children, at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,120 km away.

Vijayanagaram, also spelt Vizianagaram, is a district headquarters on the north Andhra coast, close to Visakhapatnam, with a historic fort and many schools and colleges. It is hot and humid, with heavy monsoon rain and, in some years, cyclones from the Bay of Bengal. The equipment comes by road, and our team or a dealer in south India installs it. Tell us the age range of the pupils, and we will plan the mix on a layout drawing.

items.q: What playground equipment suits children aged 8 to 12?
items.a: Climbers, overhead ladders, balancing beams and taller play towers. They test strength and balance, and should be placed apart from equipment for younger children.

items.q: Can one playground serve both younger and older pupils?
items.a: Yes, with separate zones. We plan low pieces for younger children and climbing equipment for older ones on one layout drawing, each with its safe play area.
Yes. We deliver by road from our Vasai factory, about 1,120 km away, and install with our own team or a dealer in south India.
